problem:
If
    $M=[\begin{aligned}-x \\ 3y\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $M.$
  

| ${M}^{T}=$ |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{M}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}-x & 3y\end{aligned}]
$$
